claim: Try the product in one click with isolated sample data.
where: landing primary action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; real storage seeded; enter /demo/; reset demo; assert real key is unchanged

claim: Each physical stock item is allocated only once across a BOM.
sandbox: sample demo; 10 M3 screws; two demand rows of 6; assert allocations 6 and 4 with shortage 2

claim: Imports and exports stock as CSV, including quoted comma fields.
sandbox: sample demo; reject negative quantity; import a quoted comma value; download and inspect exported CSV

claim: Optional local photos have a 2 MB file limit.
sandbox: sample demo; select a generated 5 MiB JPEG fixture; assert visible error, open dialog, and no saved part

claim: Free mode supports 40 stock parts and two builds.
where: landing facts and pricing, app About, README
sandbox: sample demo namespace seeded to both boundaries; assert a 41st part and third build are rejected

claim: A verified Bench Pass removes stock-part and build limits.
sandbox: sample demo with recorded valid verdict fixture and 40 parts; assert a 41st part saves

claim: A saved license verdict is reused for one day.
sandbox: mock Sociobot verify with a recorded valid response; reload twice; assert exactly one verification request

claim: Inventory and project data stay on the device, with no analytics or telemetry.
where: landing facts, privacy, app About, README
sandbox: fresh sample demo; exercise build and dialog flow; record every request; assert no third-party request

claim: The app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh sample demo; wait for service worker control; set browser offline; reload; assert sample stock remains usable

claim: Bench Pass costs US$12 as a one-time purchase.
where: landing facts and pricing, app About, terms
sandbox: fresh landing and terms routes; assert the same exact price and purchase type are visible

claim: The shell and PowerShell installers verify SHA-256 before installation.
sandbox: fresh built site; fetch both served scripts; assert platform checksum command and MSI execution path

claim: Release metadata is cached for one hour, with a release-page fallback when lookup fails.
sandbox: fresh landing; seed one-hour cache and block GitHub API; assert no request; remove cache and assert calm release-page fallback
